name: lit-scout
description: Spots research ideas in your chat, finds the closest papers, reads them in full and tells you whether the idea is new.

openalexKey.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
openalexKey.description: Free key from https://openalex.org/settings/api. Leave empty to use OPENALEX_API_KEY from your shell, or no key.

s2Key.title: Semantic Scholar API key (optional)
s2Key.description: Free key from https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api. Leave empty to use S2_API_KEY from your shell, or no key.

examples.title: Extra classifier examples
examples.description: Extra LIT/OTHER examples added to the trigger prompt, one per line.

debug.title: Debug lines
debug.description: Write each check's decision to the transcript instead of the debug log.
